qualifier: inherited enzyme and transporter defects, lipoxygenase/hepoxilin branch
name: Fatty acid and eicosanoid metabolism with inherited enzyme/transporter defects
rationale: Members cover fatty acid/eicosanoid synthesis, transport and 12-lipoxygenase hepoxilin products; unlike the P450 epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase confusables, the theme holds the Mendelian CYP and SLC/ABC transporter defect entries.

qualifier: Golgi hybrid/complex maturation and antenna elongation
name: Golgi N-glycan maturation and antenna elongation
rationale: All members describe Golgi trimming of Man9 to Man5, hybrid/complex branch reactions and antenna extension (poly-LacNAc, sialylation), distinguishing it from O-glycan confusables and from early ER N-glycan processing.

core: Renal regulation of blood pressure and volume
qualifier: renin-angiotensin system
name: Renin-angiotensin renal regulation of blood pressure and volume
rationale: Members concern angiotensin generation/signalling, renal sodium, urine and glomerular control of blood volume and pressure (with ACE-linked bradykinin catabolism and cGMP), unlike the vasopressin water-balance and vascular-tone confusables.

qualifier: thyroid and adrenal glucocorticoid axes
name: Thyroid hormone and adrenal glucocorticoid axis regulation
rationale: Members span thyroid hormone generation, transport and signalling plus ACTH/cortisol secretion and response with pregnenolone/progesterone synthesis, combining two axes that the GH/prolactin, stress-behaviour and steroid-biosynthesis confusables do not.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signalling and TKI resistance
qualifier: FLT3 and erythropoietin receptor, STAT5/CBL
name: FLT3 and erythropoietin receptor signalling, TKI-resistant FLT3 mutants
rationale: Members are FLT3 signalling, fusions and drug-resistant FLT3 mutants with EPO/STAT5/CBL signalling, whereas confusables cover ALK, KIT, PDGFR, FGFR mutants or other EPO branches.

qualifier: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and pre-replicative complex licensing
name: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and DNA replication licensing
rationale: Members combine E2F target/G1/S transcription with ORC/CDC6 pre-RC activation and replication checkpoints, which the replication-regulation and cell-cycle confusables lack.

qualifier: plasma cell differentiation and immunoglobulins
name: Plasma cell differentiation and immunoglobulin-expressing B cell signatures
rationale: Members are naive/memory B cell and plasma cell signatures, immunoglobulin modules and plasma cell differentiation, distinct from the B cell activation/germinal centre and T cell confusables.

qualifier: selective autophagy and aggregate clearance
name: Selective autophagy and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members cover aggrephagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy with ERAD and misfolded-protein responses, while confusables centre on chaperonin folding, stress granules or proteasomal/ribosome QC.

qualifier: dependence receptors and p75NTR death signalling
name: Neuronal apoptosis via dependence receptors and p75NTR death signalling
rationale: Members concern ligand-absent dependence-receptor caspase activation, p75NTR/NRAGE/NADE death signalling, FOXO death genes and neuron apoptosis, unlike the neurotrophin survival and processing confusables.

qualifier: mitotic and meiotic division from replication licensing to cytokinesis
name: Mitotic and meiotic cell cycle, replication licensing to cytokinesis
rationale: The 190 members span G1/S E2F control, origin licensing, G2/M, spindle, cohesion, APC/C, cytokinesis and meiotic recombination/segregation, far broader than the checkpoint, telomere and chromatin confusables.

qualifier: organic pesticides, dioxin/AhR and psychoactive drugs
name: Response to organic xenobiotics, pesticides and psychoactive drugs
rationale: Members are responses to organic chemicals (insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, dioxin via AhR, bisphenol A, ethanol, nicotine, anaesthetics), distinguishing them from the metal-ion, amine and vitamin confusables.

qualifier: crypt stem cell renewal and differentiation
name: Intestinal epithelial renewal from crypt stem cells
rationale: Members describe intestinal epithelial development, stem cell homeostasis, Wnt crypt progenitors and epithelial identity programmes, whereas confusables are mature HNF4-driven absorptive enterocyte or antimicrobial modules.

qualifier: connexin gap junctions and ion channel regulation
name: Connexin gap junction trafficking and cell-surface ion channel regulation
rationale: Members cover connexin oligomerisation, transport and annular gap junctions plus regulation of protein surface localisation and channel-dependent excitability, unlike cardiac action potential, gap junction transmission or nodal confusables.

qualifier: capacitation, acrosome reaction and zona pellucida binding
name: Fertilization: sperm capacitation, acrosome reaction and zona binding
rationale: All members concern sperm-egg interaction steps from capacitation and acrosome reaction to zona penetration and egg activation, absent from the germline, MZT and sperm motility confusables.

qualifier: folate and pterins
name: Folate and pterin one-carbon metabolism and transport
rationale: Members are folate/tetrahydrofolate interconversion, transport and response, pterins, formate and histidine-linked one-carbon metabolism, unlike cobalamin, methionine, thiamine and riboflavin confusables.

qualifier: AU-rich element-binding proteins
name: AU-rich element binding protein control of mRNA stability
rationale: Members are 3'-UTR ARE-binding proteins (TTP, BRF1, AUF1, KSRP, HuR) that destabilise or stabilise mRNA, distinct from stress granule, decapping and miRNA confusables.

core: Polymerase delta/PCNA strand synthesis and flap removal
qualifier: lagging strand, telomere C-strand and long-patch BER
name: Lagging-strand DNA synthesis and long-patch base excision repair
rationale: Members share primer synthesis, polymerase switching, strand elongation and flap removal in replication, telomere C-strand fill-in and long-patch BER gap-filling, unlike the NER and translesion-synthesis confusables.

qualifier: G protein beta-gamma control of K+ and Ca2+ channels
name: Presynaptic Gβγ regulation of potassium and calcium channels
rationale: Members describe GIRK activation, Gβγ inhibition of voltage-gated Ca2+ channels, presynaptic kainate receptor function and presynaptic membrane potential, rather than the transmitter-release confusables.

qualifier: granulocytes (neutrophils, eosinophils) and G-CSF
name: RUNX-regulated granulocytic differentiation and G-CSF signalling
rationale: Members are RUNX1/2/3 target programmes with neutrophil/eosinophil differentiation, granulopoiesis and G-CSF signalling, unlike confusables focused on HSCs, monocyte/macrophage CSF or mast cells.

qualifier: viral budding, MVB/exosomes, abscission, nuclear envelope sealing
name: ESCRT-mediated membrane scission: budding, MVBs, abscission, envelope sealing
rationale: All members are ESCRT-dependent fission events (HIV/viral budding, MVB and exosome formation, midbody abscission, NE resealing), distinct from nuclear envelope, cytokinesis and endocytic-sorting confusables.

qualifier: Th2 promotion with eosinophil migration and activation
name: Th2 cell promotion and eosinophil migration and activation
rationale: Members combine positive regulation of Th2 differentiation/IL-5 with eosinophil chemotaxis, activation and immunity, whereas confusables cover negative Th2 regulation, IL-4/13/33 signalling or granulocyte differentiation.

qualifier: chamber myocardium and septum
name: Cardiac chamber myocardium and septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern trabecular/compact ventricular and atrial myocardium plus muscular and membranous septum morphogenesis, while confusables cover early heart-tube specification or cardiomyocyte proliferation and hypertrophy.

qualifier: INK4A/ARF-p53-p21 arrest, SAHF and SASP
name: Cellular senescence via INK4A/ARF–p53 arrest and SASP
rationale: Members cover oncogene-, oxidative- and replicative senescence, p16INK4A/p14ARF defects, p53-p21 G1 arrest, SAHF, Polycomb silencing and SASP, unlike the p53 apoptosis and DNA damage checkpoint confusables.

qualifier: mature processed transcripts
name: Nuclear export of mature mRNA
rationale: All members are export of mature mRNAs (intron-containing, intronless, histone SLBP-dependent/independent, poly(A)+), unlike the 3'-end processing, nuclear pore and Rev export confusables.

qualifier: herpes simplex encephalitis
name: Inborn TLR3–TRIF pathway deficiencies in herpes simplex encephalitis
rationale: All three members are TLR3, TICAM1/TRIF or TRAF3 deficiencies causing HSE, distinguishing the theme from endosomal TLR7-9, TAK1 and IRF3/RIG-I signalling confusables.
